nonblocking_observations.result: All 24 manifest-listed artifact hashes and byte sizes match; governing input, manifest, and privacy receipt identities match expected values; all 22 JSON files parse.

The package consistently keeps the canonical journal as sole semantic/transaction-fact authority; AuthorityDB is cross-transaction lease/nonce authority only; WitnessDB is detection/witness only; ProgressDB is disposable acceleration only. No second semantic authority was found.
UNKNOWN_CONSUMED is terminal and non-retryable; automatic retry requires new owner authority, new nonce, and new barrier. The invocation gate requires journal and AuthorityDB barriers.

Journal-derived idempotency, descriptor-bound CAS ordering, Grade-1 same-host/same-UID detect-only witness claims, and SQLite/WAL FULL/BEGIN IMMEDIATE/backup/recovery partitions are substantively frozen.
Semantic-path registration is immutable and shared; semantic terminal outranks RUNNING/STALE/PID projections; nonce-ledger has exactly one directory creator and the runner never creates it.

Privacy receipt identity matches, reports zero blockers/issues, exact frozen scanner identities, 24 persistent text files and one exact tool source. Candidate zero-effect receipt contains all-zero effect counters and is internally consistent with the contract-only package.
